reason: Sources: experiments/coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt and report.json (leak5_oof, emb_* folds); research/wf_ideas_v2/r1_research_polyphase-shift-stitch-localisation.{json,notes.md}; r1_research_gate-aware-refine-head.json; r1_hyp_metric.notes.md; research/discussions_summary.md l.354-357; sibling verdict v_redteam-past_head199-x138-two-arm_value.json. The cited facts hold. The detector reads ::4 of a 1024 px xy grid. The v2 learnability test covered only the >=7 um tail. The public residual is ~1.43 um bias-free. The value does not follow from them. (1) The ceiling is capped by the xy share. Public leak5 per-axis MAE is z/y/x 1.076/0.571/0.597 um with bias 0.399/0.285/0.345. A folded-normal debias gives per-axis sd 1.29/0.66/0.66 um, so z carries 66% of the error variance. Full resolution adds no z information, because the detector already reads every z plane, and GT z is integer slices, an irreducible 0.47 um sd. By Monte Carlo, cutting xy sd by 5/10/15% moves the 3D bias-free mean only -2.1/-4.2/-6.0%. The idea's target of 1.25 um needs an xy sd cut of ~32% (0.66 -> 0.45 um). The in-domain head P, which learns the annotation convention, reached only xy MAE 0.44/0.42, and out of embryo P did not beat public at all (44b6->6bba 1.570 vs 1.567; 6bba->44b6 1.452 vs 1.296). Part of the xy residual is click noise on 'approximate cell centers' (v2: about half the offset variance is frame-level noise, lag-1 autocorrelation 0.57), and no image feature can remove it. A realistic cut from handcrafted full-res features on an unseen embryo is 0-10% of xy sd, i.e. 0 to -4% in 3D. (2) The metric barely sees sub-um shifts. match7 in leak5 is none 132,366 / public 132,326 / P 132,473, which moves by <=0.1% even for a head that shifts 45% of peaks by >=1 um. Any LB value has to come through contested assignments and x138's position-consuming tail. The LB response to localisation is at most ~+0.0008 per 1% bias-free cut, taken from x138's single +0.007 run, which is itself inside ~2 sigma of the 0.003 noise. It is ~0 on our stack, where the whole +0.002 is explained by the node multiplier. So -2..-4% gives <= +0.0015..+0.003 at the optimistic slope and ~0 at the pessimistic one. (3) The direct precedent is negative. A heuristic sub-voxel peak refinement (Eric, 77th) gave +0.0078 locally and -0.002 on the LB twice. Float output gave lab +0.0018 and an LB tie. A constant offset gave -0.0031. This idea is the same class: geometry changes that look good in the lab. (4) Transfer traps specific to this design. (a) The public xy bias is embryo-specific: 6bba +0.33/+0.42 um vs 44b6 +0.05/-0.04 um (emb folds). A residual fit on the pooled pairs, 85% 6bba (106k of 126k), learns the 6bba offset. The <0.15 um mean-shift gate only blocks the global part, and per-node features such as the centroid offset in window w still encode the 6bba click convention (hengck23: annotations sit on Ultrack segment points, sometimes 'cell corners'). (b) The detector is in-sample on all 199 train videos, so train residuals are smaller than test residuals and their structure differs. That is exactly how Eric's refinement died. The embryo-held-out split does NOT make it fair, because the peaks are in-sample in both directions; only the head cancels. (c) 44b6 is one recording in overlapping crops, so the 6bba->44b6 fold is effectively n=1 recording. (d) The adoption rule 'LB >= base + 0.001' sits inside LB noise (0.003 between byte-identical runs), so the chance of a false adopt or false reject on one embryo is ~40%. (5) Bottom line: expected public ~+0.0005..+0.001 and private about the same. Both are below the +0.002 bar and undetectable on the public LB. It costs ~6 agent-hours, one slot and ~0.8 Vitalii GPU-h.
fix_if_any: Downgrade it to a zero-cost lab diagnostic and a possible rider, never a dedicated probe. (a) First run a TRAINING-FREE physical test: on the laptop, take a pure full-res intensity centroid or parabola in xy only (no z, no learning) around the public-refined peak. Check whether it cuts debiased xy MAE vs public by >= 10% in EACH embryo separately. If a physical estimator with zero fitted parameters cannot, a learned residual only adds the convention. (b) If you learn at all: xy only, per-video debiased targets, embryos weighted 50/50. Gate PER EMBRYO on both held-out directions: 3D bias-free mean <= 0.97 x public AND xy sd <= 0.90 x public; mean shift < 0.1 um per axis; ILP node count on the dummy clips within +-1% of public, not +-3%. (c) Measure what the LB rewards: friend A's x138 lab replay with official scoring of the full tail (relink/readmit/gapfill), float coords in both arms. Adopt only if >= +0.003 there, which would be ~+0.001 after the 2-4x discount. (d) Ship it only as a passenger in a final that already needs a slot, not as its own probe; the public LB cannot resolve +0.001.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0005 (range -0.002 .. +0.002). The optimistic slope of 0.0008 per 1% cut x a realistic -2..-4% 3D cut (xy only; z is 66% of the variance and unchanged) gives <= +0.003 lab-equivalent. After the precedent discount (Eric -0.002, float out tie) the expected value is ~+0.0005-0.001, below the +0.002 bar and the 0.003 noise.
realistic_private_gain: ~+0.0005 (range -0.002 .. +0.002). The physical features transfer slightly more evenly than embryo-identity features. But the target is learned 85% from 6bba (xy bias +0.35 um there vs ~0 on 44b6), and the residuals come from an in-sample detector, so the transfer is not better than the public head's. On embryos annotated like 44b6 the sign may be negative.
critical_path: Mechanically: 26 Sep, patch extraction + features + fit + gate on the laptop that has the local train zarr and captures (~4 h CPU), then the kernel patch after _v1284_refine plus a byte-identity-when-off test via tools/build_probe_kernel.py (~2 h agent). ~16:00 UTC 26 Sep, Vitalii's private dummy run (~0.8 GPU-h). ~18:00 UTC 26 Sep, submit; scored ~01:00-04:00 UTC 27 Sep, well before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC. The time path fits. But the pre-registered gate (M2 <= 0.95 x public on BOTH embryo-held-out directions) needs a >=12% xy-sd cut out of embryo, and P out of embryo gave 0% and +12% worse. So the probe will probably never be earned (P(gate pass) ~0.2, a guess), and if it is, its LB result cannot be told apart from noise. Not recommended for a slot.
